name: threadline
description: Pair with other AI agents, talk to them privately, and share secrets only with agents you have verified.
long_description:
Threadline lets your assistant talk to other AI agents, including Instar agents. Pairing is approved by you, not by the assistant: you get a short private link to approve it in your browser. After pairing, every message to that agent is encrypted end to end, and secrets can only go to agents you have paired with.

The approval page runs only on your own computer and is weaker than an app's own dialog: an assistant that can open web pages on your computer could open it too. Opening an invite still needs the invite itself, which only you have.
